route_summary: Baseline census done: z(n) exact to 10^5 (two independent implementations agree), z(n) <= 5 witnessed to 10^7 and checked to 10^8. The exceptional set {z >= 4} has 38 members, all <= 6234; whether it is finite is the standing question.

attempts.range: z(n) exact for 2 <= n <= 1e5 (independent re-implementation, tables identical); z(n) <= 5 with certificates for n <= 1e7 (every witness independently re-verified); n <= 1e8 single-implementation check only
attempts.one_line: z(n) <= 5 holds to 10^8; exactly 38 n <= 10^5 need 4 or 5, none past 6234, and first witnesses concentrate at the left edge of the bounded-quotient Cantor set.
